facts.fact: Beautiful eyebrows, as if drawn with a brush
facts.quote: 붓으로 그린 듯한 주화란의 아름다운 눈썹이

facts.fact: Extraordinarily beautiful; beauty beyond simple description
facts.quote: 단순히 예쁘다, 아름답다라는 말로는 주화란의 미모를 제대로 설명할 길이 없다.

facts.fact: Beautiful face with a cold impression
facts.quote: 검을 늘어트린 주화란은 아름다웠고, 한편으로는 차가웠다.

facts.fact: Strikingly beautiful even without any makeup
facts.quote: 다른 여인들과 달리 화장기 하나 없는 얼굴임에도 뭐라 형용할 수 없을 만한 아름다움이 흘러나왔고

facts.fact: Wears a plain, single-colored martial outfit
facts.quote: 그녀가 걸친 단조로운 색의 무복은 화려한 궁장보다 기품 있어 보였다

facts.fact: Dark blue (blue-black) eyes with a mysterious sheen
Eyes curve like half-moons when smiling
Carries a sword in a scabbard at her waist

ranges.description: Ju Hwaran is a strikingly beautiful woman with an elegant yet cold face, bare of any makeup, and eyebrows that look brush-drawn. Her clear, dark blue (blue-black) eyes have a mysterious sheen and curve like half-moons when she smiles. She wears a plain, single-colored martial outfit and carries a sword in a scabbard at her waist. Tags: female, beautiful, cold impression, brush-like eyebrows, dark blue eyes, clear eyes, half-moon smile eyes, no makeup, plain martial outfit, single color clothing, sword, scabbard at waist
